description: Conversions between lifetime (ns), capture rate (1/us) and capture probability (%) with the master tables of tests/fixtures ('q': a Huff factor given by the user). 'refused': master tables the conversion must refuse, and values that are not a Huff factor.

huff.description: Huff factor Q: reduction of the decay rate of a muon bound in the 1s orbit, Lambda_decay = Q / tau(mu+). by_nuclide is used when the mass number is known, by_element otherwise; Q = 1 is assumed when neither has an entry.
